g.text: The pointer does not redirect the recall without the J++ part
Locker before the pick; the pointer written toward another locker on top of the change
without the J++ part. Black: the written locker's item with its 95% interval; thin lines:
the rule's bars, ≥ 30 under (ii) and ≤ 5 under (iv), on 2 of 3 models.
